description:
Execute one live-web operation — search, read, extract, evidence, research, compare, changes, or decision — in a single paid request without orchestrating multiple web APIs. Use intent 'decision' to search the live web and return decision-ready ranked results with relevance and confidence.
USE WHEN: agent needs a live web search, multi-page read, structured extraction, comparative research, evidence gathering, web change detection, or decision-ready ranked search results.
DO NOT USE WHEN: agent already has a single known URL and only needs its clean readable text; use search-read instead. This product does not perform fact-checking or truth verification; confidence reflects query↔result relevance only.
Parameter semantics: supply `intent` plus only that intent's fields; without `intent`, supply legacy `topic` and `objective` together.
